-- Primeiro obter o ID de Jenifer
SET @jenifer_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'jenifer.borges@influx.com.br' LIMIT 1);

-- Criar perfil de estudante
INSERT INTO student_profiles (userId, currentBookId, currentUnit, englishLevel, learningGoal, studyHoursPerWeek, totalStudyHours, currentStreak, longestStreak, lastActivityAt, status, createdAt, updatedAt)
VALUES (
  @jenifer_id,
  5, -- Book 5
  10, -- Unit 10
  'advanced',
  'career',
  15,
  520, -- 520 horas de estudo
  52, -- 52 dias de streak
  60, -- maior streak de 60 dias
  NOW(),
  'active',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);
